epistemic_status: DECISION-SYSTEM SPECIFICATION. A staking policy is a frozen rule set evaluated in shadow before any real-money question is even well-posed. This node specifies and backtests-in-shadow; activating any policy with money is USER_REQUIRED and is not this node's decision.
authority: M00 contract evidence_ladder and execution_mode_ladder; D024 SHADOW default; S42 CLOSED

real_money_activation.statement: No rule in this specification authorises a real-money stake. Activating any policy with money is a mode transition, is never self-grantable by this lane, and is outside this node entirely. Every figure below is notional.

eligibility_gate.rule: A class may receive a NON-ZERO real-money stake only while it holds M00 evidence-ladder rank 7 (PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE), which by the contract's own definition requires all six lower labels held simultaneously, hard risk controls verified, and the mode transition granted.
eligibility_gate.shadow_rule: In SHADOW any class may be SIZED for evaluation, but the size is notional and carries no authorisation.
eligibility_gate.ladder_status_source: NONE EXISTS. The M00 taxonomy records no evidence labels per class, so there is no machine-readable ladder status for this gate to read. Until one exists the gate must FAIL CLOSED: every class is treated as holding rank 0.

sizing.method: fractional Kelly on the LOWER CONFIDENCE BOUND of the edge, never on the point estimate
sizing.uncertainty_propagation: The edge input is an estimate with an interval. Kelly evaluated at a point estimate treats an uncertain edge as certain and systematically oversizes. This policy therefore evaluates Kelly at the 95% lower confidence bound. If the interval includes zero, the lower bound is <= 0, the Kelly fraction is <= 0, and the stake is ZERO by arithmetic rather than by judgement.
sizing.kelly_fraction_cap_rationale: Quarter-Kelly. A judgement, recorded as one: it is not derived from anything measured in this programme.
sizing.min_edge_rule: strictly greater than zero; an edge whose lower bound is exactly zero stakes nothing

exposure_caps_pct_of_bankroll.note: Caps bind in the order listed; the binding cap is recorded on every sized decision so a stake can always be traced to the rule that limited it.

liquidity_and_quote_rules.max_quote_age_rationale: The capture cadence is 5 minutes (M03). A quote older than one full cadence cannot be shown to have been standing.
liquidity_and_quote_rules.min_liquidity_source: M21 measured median depth at best price on real resting orders
liquidity_and_quote_rules.book_side_limits: ABSENT. M21 marked sportsbook maximum-stake UNMEASURED rather than estimating it. This policy does not supply a number M21 refused to invent, and treats exchange depth as the only evidenced liquidity bound.

drawdown_and_stop_rules.on_stop: All sizing returns zero. Re-enabling is USER_REQUIRED and is not self-grantable.
drawdown_and_stop_rules.global_kill_switch: Manual, always available, and re-enabling it is USER_REQUIRED.

measured_expectations_at_freeze.note: What this programme has actually measured for each class, with its source. These are the inputs the sizing rule consumes. None is a positive lower bound.

PURE_MICROSTRUCTURE.expectation: ZERO as income; it is a cost reduction on money already staked

STALE_LINE_DELAYED_REACTION.source: M08: 52% of episodes sit at the capture resolution floor

TRUE_CROSS_BOOK_ARBITRAGE.expectation: POSITIVE BUT IMMATERIAL, 0.20-0.83 USD per occurrence

MODEL_VS_MARKET_VALUE.expectation: NO EDGE, and forbidden here regardless

PROMOTIONAL_VALUE.expectation: LARGEST PER-UNIT VALUE MEASURED, but no real offer has ever been entered

hard_risk_controls_coverage.note: Mapping onto the eleven controls M00 requires before any non-SHADOW order.
hard_risk_controls_coverage.minimum_edge: covered -- sizing.min_edge_after_uncertainty on the lower bound
hard_risk_controls_coverage.per_game_and_per_player_exposure_caps: PARTIAL -- per-game covered; PER-PLAYER IS NOT, because the board's classes are game-level and no per-player exposure is currently computed
hard_risk_controls_coverage.no_duplicate_or_correlated_order_conflic: NOT COVERED -- correlation between legs across markets on the same game is not modelled here
hard_risk_controls_coverage.no_trading_through_a_suspension: NOT COVERED -- M17 suspension microstructure is not built

known_gaps: No machine-readable per-class evidence-ladder status exists, so the eligibility gate fails closed on every class.
Three of the eleven M00 hard risk controls are not covered by this specification and are named above rather than glossed.
The Kelly cap of 0.25 is a judgement and is not derived from anything this programme measured.
Correlated exposure across markets within one game is not modelled; caps are per-market and per-game but assume independence between them.
